subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option fo fill in the blank. **

Police used ______ evidence to convict a victim who was innocent.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2**' i.e.** "fabricated".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In this context, **the sentence implies that the police used false evidence to wrongly convict an innocent person.
 
• The word **"fabricated"** means made up or false.(गढ़ा हुआ)
 
• It aligns well with the context as it suggests that the evidence was created or manipulated dishonestly to achieve a certain outcome (in this case, an unjust conviction).

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *'Police used **fabricated **evidence to convict a victim who was innocent.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's explain why the other options are not suitable:
 
 
• **"Stunted" **generally refers to something that is prevented from growing or developing properly, which doesn't fit in the context of evidence in a criminal case.(अवरुद्ध)
 
• **"Hateful"** refers to something inspiring or deserving hate. It is an adjective more commonly used to describe feelings or attitudes, rather than evidence.(घृणित)
 
• **"Authentic" **means genuine or real. If the evidence was authentic, the person convicted would not likely be innocent, which contradicts the context of the sentence.(प्रामाणिक)
